patterns.note: Feature showcase with animated UI mockups: Many sections feature a large, detailed UI mockup or illustration that animates to demonstrate a feature, often accompanied by descriptive text and statistics.

Progressive content reveal on scroll: Sections and their internal elements (especially UI mockups and statistics) fade in or slide up as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic browsing experience.

Brand blue as primary interactive accent: A consistent, bright blue is used exclusively for primary call-to-action buttons, links, and key interactive elements, standing out against a largely neutral palette.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered animations to progressively reveal content. As the user scrolls, entire sections, individual text blocks, and detailed UI mockups animate into view with subtle fade-up or slide-in transitions. The main navigation bar also transforms, becoming sticky and slightly more compact after the initial scroll depth. The hero section features a looping background video.

Information is structured into distinct, full-width sections with ample vertical padding, creating a clean and airy layout. Many sections utilize a split-layout, pairing a large, illustrative UI mockup or data visualization on one side with concise descriptive text and key statistics on the other, often alternating the visual's position for rhythm. Primary calls-to-action are rendered as solid, high-contrast blue buttons, while secondary actions are presented as outlined buttons or simple text links.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (H1 ~3-4x body text) establish clear hierarchy, complemented by a readable sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons, cards, and input fields feature a slight, consistent corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and comfortable internal padding within content blocks.

standout: The site effectively uses animated, detailed UI mockups and data visualizations within its feature sections to dynamically illustrate complex software capabilities, making the product feel tangible and engaging without requiring a live demo. This goes beyond static screenshots or simple icons, providing a clear and interactive understanding of the product's value.
